protocol.rule: Choose one of two fixed ridge models by 2024 margin error, evaluate 2025, and report 2026 separately. Fit each season on earlier seasons only. Choose one of five market weights using earlier 2026 margin error.
protocol.limits: Historical replay. Existing results had been inspected before these experiments. Closing lines are available for only the original 182 games and are not matched to original forecast times. Blend probabilities use earlier-period residuals; earlier-period calibration is in-sample. No automated model promotion.
protocol.coverage: Score and schedule features across 2016–2026 regular-season history. Play efficiency, line metrics and injuries are not available consistently across these seasons. Historical team coverage follows the existing schedule archive and postseason coverage is incomplete.
